paraphrase: Kṣitigarbha, in past lives as the brahmin girl whose mother was in hell and as a king, vowed to deliver all beings of the six destinies before becoming a buddha: 'only when the hells are empty will I become a buddha'; offerings and recitation for the dead during the forty-nine days help them.
